headlines.title: Génocide des Rohingya : la Birmanie refusera les exigences de la CIJ qu'elle juge "inappropriées"
headlines.summary: Alors que la Cour internationale de justice a établi la responsabilité de l'État birman dans le génocide des Rohingya, le dirigeant Min Aung Hlaing a affirmé mercredi que son pays ne "se conformera pas aux exigences qu'elle juge inappropriées".

headlines.title: US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China
headlines.summary: The new levies would hit many of America's biggest trading partners, including China and the EU.

headlines.title: Macy's postpones Thanksgiving parade due to severe weather
headlines.summary: The was the first time ever that the iconic celebration was delayed because of storms. New York expects damaging winds and heavy rainfall over the Thanksgiving holiday.

headlines.title: FedEx plane overshoots Miami runway, with flights briefly suspended at airport
headlines.summary: The brief ground stop comes on the day before the US Thanksgiving holiday, one of the busiest travel days of the year.

headlines.title: UK government set to publish new treaties agreed with EU
headlines.summary: The BBC understands the treaties contain a 10-year termination clause to reimburse costs of any need to rebuild border checks infrastructure.

headlines.title: California warns of flooding as King Tides peak over Thanksgiving
headlines.summary: Parts of the Canadian province of British Columbia may also be affected by the storms and flooding, which come as millions of people travel for the holiday.

headlines.title: US Army says controlled blast of explosives in Iowa was 'huge success'
headlines.summary: Despite widespread concern from residents ahead of the blast, officials say that lead readings in the area so far have been promising.

headlines.title: US approves SpaceX plan to send a million data satellites to space
headlines.summary: The Starmind constellation aims to be the most cost and energy-efficient way to meet the growing demand for AI computing power.

headlines.title: Guitar wars - the transatlantic battle over the Stratocaster
headlines.summary: US company Fender is in dispute with a German firm that makes generic versions of its key model.

headlines.title: Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt settle legal battle over French winery
headlines.summary: The Hollywood A-listers' legal battle focused on the vineyard they bought in 2008 and where they wed six years later.

headlines.title: Andy Taylor, ex-guitariste de Duran Duran, est décédé à l'âge de 65 ans
headlines.summary: Le guitariste britannique Andy Taylor, dont le jeu a contribué à forger le son de Duran Duran, groupe phare de la new wave des années 1980, est décédé lundi d'un cancer de la prostate, ont annoncé ses proches mercredi.

headlines.title: Violences du 17 octobre à Marseille : des ordres donnés pour "relâcher" des casseurs, selon le maire
headlines.summary: Devant la commission d'enquête de l'Assemblée nationale, le maire de Marseille Benoît Payan a déclaré mercredi que la police municipale avait reçu l'ordre de relâcher des pillards interpellés lors des violences du 17 octobre. L'édile s'étonne par ailleurs du "très faible nombre de gardes à vue".
